content.text: Section 24 fully meets the preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position in full: Customer may assign without consent to an Affiliate or to a successor by merger, reorganization, acquisition or substantial asset sale (24.1, with only a prompt-notice and assumption requirement); Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a direct competitor (24.2); other assignments are subject to a mutual, reasonableness-qualified consent standard (24.3); and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on Customer's change of control. Section 9 contains no change-of-control or assignment-based termination trigger against us (9.2 also confirms a lawful reorganization is not itself grounds for termination), and Section 13 lets us transfer licence rights to a permitted assignee. No walk-away features are present; no redline required.
